commits.message:
perf(p2): reuse validated genesis and measure isolated capacity without relaxing gates

Preserve full event replay, authorization, task generation, certificates, transaction rollback and effect uniqueness. Batch selected event reads and mapping inserts; reuse an identical validated revision inside one repeatable-read transaction. Add bounded process/client/SQL observations and two independent-process CI repeats for every original 50/200 capacity cell.

Verified 146 unit/contract and 41 real PostgreSQL focused tests, 10-agent TCP smoke, failed-SQL timing counterexample and five full-snapshot paired replay comparisons. Capacity remains gated on original targets; no merge or production claim. Preserve historical context experiment under its exact pinned core and add current-core replay evidence.
